name: Marwynn Holdings Inc. Common stock
summary: Marwynn Holdings, Inc. functions as a parent company, overseeing its operations primarily via its two subsidiaries, FuAn Enterprise, Inc. and Grand Forest Cabinetry Inc. The firm's core expertise lies in providing robust supply chain management, encompassing a diverse array of offerings such as food items, snack products, non-alcoholic refreshments, kitchen cabinetry, various flooring materials, and general home enhancement goods. Beyond these, it also delivers specialized consulting for supply chains and comprehensive assistance for market penetration strategies. Established in 2024, Marwynn Holdings maintains its corporate headquarters in Irvine, California.
